scenarios.name: Bilbo 40+ each — Event-Drain Creature Pile
scenarios.description: Conservative exact-library route for 3 opponents at 40 life. Bilbo must be ready/untapped at 111+ life with 2WBG available. Fetch Bogwater Lumaret, Dina, Marauding Blight-Priest, Corpse Knight, ANY 2 of Daxos / Elas / Prosperous Innkeeper, plus ANY 1 additional creature from the filler package = 7 entering creatures. Bogwater produces 7 lifegain events; the two selected 'another creature enters' lifegain creatures produce 6 each, for 19 lifegain events. Dina + Marauding drain each opponent 19 + 19 = 38. Corpse Knight sees the other 6 creatures and drains each opponent 6 more: 44 life loss to EACH opponent. Doctor Strange is a preferred filler because it doubles the life gained, but it is not mathematically required for this route. Scenario is intentionally strict: fetch pieces must still be in Library.

packages.name: 2 ETB Lifegain Engines
packages.description: Any two supply 6 additional lifegain events each in the 7-creature Bilbo batch.

packages.description: Any extra creature brings the Bilbo ETB batch from six to seven. Doctor Strange is the preferred high-upside member, but the 44-each event-drain math does not require its doubling effect.

scenarios.name: Bilbo 40+ each — Amount-Drain Creature Pile
scenarios.description: Creature-only amount-based drain route. Fetch Doctor Strange, Honor Troll, Bogwater Lumaret, Vito, Defiant Bloodlord, plus ANY 2 of Daxos / Elas / Prosperous Innkeeper = 7 creatures. Lifegain-event count is 7 + 6 + 6 = 19. For each base gain-1 event, choose Honor Troll's +1 before Doctor Strange's x2, so each event gains 4 life. Vito and Defiant each trigger on all 19 events: 38 targeted triggers of 4 = 152 total targetable life loss. Distribute at least 10 triggers to each of three opponents = 40 each (120 total), with 8 triggers spare. Bilbo itself is exiled as the activation cost, so Bilbo's +1 replacement is NOT included in this math.

requirements.card: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenarios.name: Bilbo 40+ each — Sanguine Bond already online
scenarios.description: Sanguine Bond is already on the battlefield, so the fetched pile can use redundancy. Fetch Doctor Strange, Honor Troll, Bogwater Lumaret, ANY 1 of Vito / Defiant Bloodlord, and ANY 2 of Daxos / Elas / Prosperous Innkeeper = 6 creatures. Lifegain-event count: Bogwater 6 + two ETB lifegain engines 5 each = 16. Honor +1 then Doctor x2 turns every gain-1 event into gain 4. Sanguine Bond plus the selected creature amount-drainer produce 2 triggers per event: 32 targeted triggers of 4 = 128 targetable life loss. Allocate 10 triggers (40) to each of three opponents; 2 triggers remain. Bilbo is exiled before these triggers resolve, so his own +1 replacement is not counted.
